newsitem.title: USA: Koo Koo Roo to purchase 14 Hamburger Hamlet stores.
newsitem.headline: Koo Koo Roo to purchase 14 Hamburger Hamlet stores.

text.p: Koo Koo Roo Inc Thursday said it plans to acquire 14 Hamburger Hamlet Restaurants Inc restaurants for approximately $11.45 million.

In a statement, the company said the purchase price consists of $9.7 million in cash and 150,000 shares of restricted common stock, plus the assumption of the leases covering the acquired restaurants.

Based on the review of the historical financial information of Hamburger Hamlet, Koo Koo Roo management presently expects the acquisition to be immediately accretive to Koo Koo Roo's consolidated operating cash flow.

Of the units subject to the letter of intent, 10 are located in California and four are in the Washington, D.C. Beltway area. Although based in California, Koo Koo Roo already has one restaurant under construction in the Washington, D.C. area and additional units are in the planning stage.
The purchase, if completed, will be financed through a debt package which the company is negotiating or through the application of cash on hand.
